nodes.label: outlines package
nodes.desc: Re-exports Generator, Application, Template, inputs, models, types and cache controls.

nodes.label: Generator / SteerableGenerator
nodes.desc: Factory dispatching on SteerableModel vs BlackBoxModel; builds the logits processor once at construction and resets it per call.

nodes.label: Application
nodes.desc: Binds a function annotated with Template and an output type into a reusable Generator pipeline.

nodes.label: Template / Vision
nodes.desc: Jinja-based prompt templates built from strings, files or Python function signatures; Vision attaches images.

nodes.label: Image / Video / Audio / Chat
nodes.desc: Multimodal input wrappers and the Chat message list passed to model type adapters.

nodes.label: disk cache
nodes.desc: diskcache-backed store for compiled artifacts; get_cache, disable_cache, clear_cache.

nodes.label: outlines.types
nodes.desc: Exports the DSL (Regex, CFG, JsonSchema, Choice), combinators (either, between, one_or_more) and locale types.

nodes.label: Term DSL & to_regex
nodes.desc: Term hierarchy (String, Regex, CFG, JsonSchema, KleeneStar, Alternatives, Sequence); python_types_to_terms maps dataclasses, TypedDicts, pydantic models and Literals to terms; to_regex lowers terms to regex strings.

nodes.label: type predicates
nodes.desc: is_pydantic_model, is_typed_dict, is_literal and friends, plus get_schema_from_signature for function-typed outputs.

nodes.label: schema converters
nodes.desc: Turns JSON schema dicts into pydantic models, TypedDicts or dataclasses for validation.

nodes.label: grammars loader
nodes.desc: read_grammar loads bundled .lark files; exposes the json, arithmetic and common grammars.

nodes.label: json.lark
nodes.desc: Lark definition of JSON used whenever a plain Python dict is the output type.

nodes.label: backend registry
nodes.desc: Default backend names (outlines_core for JSON/regex, llguidance for CFG) and get_*_logits_processor entry points.

nodes.label: BaseBackend
nodes.desc: Abstract contract every backend fulfils: build processors from JSON schema, regex or CFG.

nodes.label: OutlinesCoreBackend
nodes.desc: Extracts vocabulary from HF, llama.cpp or MLX tokenizers, builds outlines-core Vocabulary/Index, and its processor fills token bitmasks per step.

nodes.label: LLGuidanceBackend
nodes.desc: Wraps Microsoft llguidance grammars; the only backend supporting context-free grammars today.

nodes.label: XGrammarBackend
nodes.desc: xgrammar-backed compiled-grammar processor for transformers and MLX models.

nodes.label: OutlinesLogitsProcessor
nodes.desc: __call__ reshapes input_ids/logits to 2D then calls process_logits; subclasses mask scores and reset per generation.

nodes.label: tensor adapter registry
nodes.desc: Maps 'torch', 'numpy', 'mlx' to TorchTensorAdapter, NumpyTensorAdapter, MLXTensorAdapter.

nodes.label: TensorAdapter protocol
nodes.desc: Abstract shape/unsqueeze/concatenate/to_device surface so processors stay tensor-library agnostic.

nodes.label: TorchTensorAdapter
nodes.desc: torch implementation used by HF transformers and most serving stacks.

nodes.label: NumpyTensorAdapter
nodes.desc: numpy implementation used by llama.cpp-style backends.

nodes.label: MLXTensorAdapter
nodes.desc: Apple MLX implementation for on-device generation.

nodes.label: model zoo
nodes.desc: from_* constructors and the SteerableModel, BlackBoxModel, AsyncBlackBoxModel unions that Generator dispatches on.

nodes.label: Model & ModelTypeAdapter
nodes.desc: ABCs: Model.generate/generate_batch/generate_stream and ModelTypeAdapter.format_input/format_output_type.

nodes.label: Tokenizer protocol
nodes.desc: Hashable protocol requiring encode, convert_token_to_string and EOS access; caches by hash.

nodes.label: Transformers
nodes.desc: Wraps PreTrainedModel + tokenizer; format_output_type returns the processor passed straight into HF generate.

nodes.label: LlamaCpp
nodes.desc: llama.cpp binding with its own LlamaCppTokenizer and numpy tensor library.

nodes.label: MLXLM
nodes.desc: mlx-lm wrapper reusing TransformerTokenizer and the mlx tensor adapter for Apple silicon.

nodes.label: VLLM server
nodes.desc: Black-box client for a vLLM OpenAI-compatible server; passes JSON schema via guided decoding, reuses OpenAITypeAdapter.

nodes.label: VLLMOffline
nodes.desc: In-process vLLM LLM engine; converts types to regex and runs SteeringLogitsProcessor locally.

nodes.label: OpenAI client
nodes.desc: Black-box model translating JsonSchema/CFG types into OpenAI structured-output request fields.

nodes.label: provider exceptions
nodes.desc: normalize_provider_errors maps provider SDK errors onto Outlines APIError subclasses.

nodes.label: outlines-core wheel
nodes.desc: Pins outlines_core==0.2.14: the Rust crate exporting Vocabulary, Index, Guide plus torch/numpy/mlx bitmask kernels.
